scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: npx prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.prisma && node server/src/server.js
